description: "Evolution" by Rev. Edward Hoare, M.A. is a scientific publication likely written in the late 19th century. The book engages critically with the theory of evolution, especially the ideas popularized by Charles Darwin and others, as it explores the implications of these theories on both the understanding of natural history and theological perspectives.
